The '''B5B''' was a model of [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bike]] developed by [[K-NorCo]], used sometime after the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="Cartel Market" />
